title: Vistas Esmeralda | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties

description_expanded: Vistas Esmerelda - Luxury Vacation Rental Home with Beach Views Favorite Features: - Community Pool - 3 Minute Walk to Beach - Private Community - Gulf Views More about Vistas Esmeralda: Welcome to Vistas Esmeralda, a showstopping coastal retreat in Blue Mountain Beach where modern luxury meets effortless coastal charm—just a 3-minute walk from the sugar-white sands of 30A. This 3,600-square-foot retreat is designed for relaxation, connection, and Gulf-view living, offering space for up to 14 guests across four beautifully appointed bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. From the moment you arrive, the home’s clean Mediterranean-inspired exterior and swaying palm trees set a serene tone. Inside, a fresh, airy design embraces natural light and open-concept flow. The main living area features oversized windows and sliding glass doors that lead to spacious balconies—offering glimpses of the Gulf and salty breezes that remind you the beach is just steps away. Whether you're curled up in a plush chair with a book, gathered on the oversized sectional with family, or enjoying a drink outside, the coastal atmosphere surrounds you. The gourmet kitchen is a dream for home chefs, featuring custom cabinetry, designer lighting, stainless steel high-end appliances, and a large island with seating for four. In the kitchen, a complimentary coffee bar awaits, fully stocked to keep your mornings energizing and your afternoons cozy. Brew a cup and head to one of the balconies to catch the sea breeze. Four spacious bedrooms provide restful sanctuaries for guests, including a king suite and two queen rooms with en-suite baths, plus a bunk room with two built-in full-over-full bunks and a TV—a perfect hideaway for younger travelers. Each space is thoughtfully styled in soft coastal tones and curated comfort. Outside, guests can enjoy access to a sparkling community pool, relax on the sun-drenched balconies, or fire up the grill for a laid-back dinner at home. The home includes four complimentary bikes to explore the best of 30A, with nearby beach access, boutique shopping, and local dining just minutes away. Whether you're planning a family vacation, couples’ getaway, or a special celebration, Vistas Esmeralda offers the perfect blend of elevated design and laid-back beach vibes. With views like these, your only job is to relax, breathe deep, and let the Gulf set your pace. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: 2 Full over Full Bunks & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Private Balcony & Gulf View.
